title: From Blocked to Earning: A Real Payment Infrastructure for South Asian Creators Story
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

content.text: In Pakistan, digital creators face significant challenges in selling their products online due to restrictions on platforms like Stripe and PayPal, severely limiting their ability to reach international buyers. This infrastructure gap hinders their potential earnings and growth. The absence of a reliable payment system forces many to seek alternative, often unreliable methods. However, there's a solution that leverages blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure to remove these geographic barriers entirely.
The Situation Before the Stack

Before discovering the sovereign commerce infrastructure, many creators in South Asia, including Pakistan, relied on makeshift solutions or local payment methods that were either unreliable or limited in their reach. This not only affected their sales but also their ability to deliver digital products securely and efficiently. The lack of a robust infrastructure meant that creators had to navigate through a maze of workarounds, which were not only time-consuming but also prone to errors.
Why Conventional Options Had Already Failed

Conventional payment options had failed these creators due to the restrictive policies of major payment platforms. The absence of these services in their regions or the stringent requirements for account verification made it nearly impossible for creators to sell their digital products internationally. This led to a significant loss of potential revenue and hindered the growth of the digital economy in these areas.
The Infrastructure That Was Deployed

The solution came in the form of a sovereign digital commerce stack that included GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This stack provided creators with a fully operational online store that could accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a minimal fee of 0.5% and no need for KYC or buyer accounts.
Sovereign infrastructure removes geographic payment barriers.
What Happened After Going Live

After deploying the sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators in South Asia witnessed a significant increase in their sales. The ability to accept international payments securely and efficiently opened up new markets for them. With the automatic delivery of digital products and the elimination of intermediaries, creators could now focus on producing high-quality content, knowing that their payment infrastructure was robust and reliable.
The Lessons That Apply to Your Situation

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost, under their own accounts, with full data ownership from day one.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer. The delivery email arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. Nothing in this sequence requires the buyer to have a bank account, a credit card, or a PayPal account. Nothing requires you to be in a supported country.
Blockchain-based payments enable international sales without intermediaries.
